formal_statement: (h : M ≤ₚ N) : ∃ (κ : Kernel Ω' Ω) (_ : IsMarkovKernel κ), ∀ (ω : 𝓢[ℝ, E]) (hω : ω.IsNormal), (M.probabilityLaw ω hω : Measure Ω) = κ ∘ₘ N.probabilityLaw ω hω

conditions: finite measurable outcome spaces X and Y, with measurable singletons
one selected finite family of normal states of the same E
one state-independent Markov kernel κ for every selected state
open_obligations: formalize and check the finite singleton expansion against pinned Physlib in one Lean environment
independently review source semantics, channel orientation, and normal-state quantifiers
do not infer the Physlib all-state relation from a sampled-state matrix fit
out.rationale: Evaluating μ_M^ω = κ ∘ₘ μ_N^ω on singleton outcomes suggests K₁(y|s)=ΣₓK₂(x|s)G(y|x). A common-environment Lean proof of the finite singleton expansion and independent source review have not been completed.
out.scope: one-way finite normal-state/outcome restriction of a Physlib Born-law factorization

out.rationale: The lemma's premise names the source postprocessing relation via ≤ₚ. This records source syntax, not a kernel-extracted proof dependency.
